## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Restore the documented `--wait` compatibility alias: existing invocations currently fail instead of receiving the promised transition period. This review read the complete diff, all changed files, and the tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request renames `--wait` to `--timeout`, updates parser tests, and documents a transition that preserves the default and output formats. It also adds `review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Preserve the deprecated `--wait` alias — For `parse_args(["--wait", "12"])`, the parser now exits with an unrecognized-argument error. You register only `--timeout`, although docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5 states, “Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used.” — Existing scripts using `--wait` stop working during the documented compatibility period. — Fix: Accept both options into `args.timeout` and emit the documented deprecation warning when `--wait` is used.
